checkpoints.description: [1/2] Read-only sidecars: JSON/XMP export for selected photos with tags, Places and camera; ZIP endpoint and selection UI; [2/2] tests, gates, Chromium review and publish

impact_assessment.why: The remaining safe interoperability gap is a sidecar export that never rewrites originals
impact_assessment.benefits: Users can take Harbor tags, GPS and camera metadata into other tools as JSON or XMP, without file mutation or network services
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new ZIP endpoint and two UI actions; dependency: stdlib zipfile/XML only; concurrency: read-only; state: no schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every hash through selection.visible, keep filenames collision-safe, test JSON/XMP/ZIP and privacy, gate and review

[1/2] Lens filter: lens=NAME query, outline lens counts, Lenses rail and tests; [2/2] gates, Chromium review and publish

impact_assessment.why: Lens strings are already stored with camera metadata; exposing a lens filter closes the remaining local metadata-search gap
impact_assessment.benefits: A read-only Lenses rail and exact lens filter using stored EXIF data, no new schema or file changes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new lens query field and outline entry; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: read-only; state: unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Mirror the proven camera filter, validate privacy through the catalog, add unit/HTTP/static tests, gate and review

[1/2] Harden HTTP tests against intermittent ConnectionAbortedError with a fresh socket per request and a dedicated keep-alive test; [2/2] repeat suite, gates and publish

impact_assessment.why: The HTTP suite intermittently aborts a reused keep-alive socket on Windows, making 4/4 gates flaky and obscuring real failures
impact_assessment.benefits: Reliable test evidence while still covering one explicit keep-alive exchange
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test harness only; dependency: none; concurrency: fresh sockets avoid stale shared state; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use a per-call connection plus Connection: close, add a keep-alive regression test, run the suite repeatedly and publish

checkpoints.description: [1/2] HTTP test harness uses a fresh socket and Connection: close per call; added a dedicated keep-alive two-request test
[1/2] Flake fix verified: 3 consecutive 279-test runs OK; 4/4 gates; checklists: passed

[1/2] Read-only Folders view: /api/folders tree from per-person year/month copies, Folders tab and month navigation, tests; [2/2] gates, Chromium review and publish

impact_assessment.why: The plain per-person year/month folders are a deliberate feature; exposing them read-only makes the layout browsable without duplicating the filesystem
impact_assessment.benefits: A testable folder tree with real person/month paths and one-click gallery navigation, no schema or file changes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new folders endpoint and tab; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: read-only; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse catalog.outline for counts, enforce owner/non-owner visibility, add unit/HTTP/static tests, gate and review

[1/2] Timeline scrubber: year/month selects and older/newer jumps over outline months, static/HTTP tests; [2/2] gates, Chromium review and publish

impact_assessment.why: The outline already has every month and count; a compact jump control makes large libraries navigable without adding virtual scrolling or state
impact_assessment.benefits: Fast year/month jumps from the gallery, no schema or backend change, works with the existing month scope
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new Photos controls and outline state; dependency: browser only; concurrency: read-only; state: no new storage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the controls derived from outline months, test the static wiring and outline ordering, review with two different years, gate and publish
